title: Decision: TLS handshake failures log at debug and continue
description: In the main.rs TLS accept loop, a failed TLS handshake is logged at tracing::debug! and the loop continues (not breaks). This is correct for two reasons: (1) a bad handshake from one peer is a normal event (scanner, misconfigured client, wrong port) and must not kill the accept loop for all other peers; (2) debug level is appropriate because in production this will be noisy from tailnet scanners, while the accept loop itself logging at info/error preserves signal-to-noise. Logging at warn or error and/or breaking would be incorrect.
